Effects of this pollution include nausea, drowsiness, irritability and headaches. For several years, Hippocrates has recommended that people walk and use public transportation whenever possible. Plant trees, flowers, and petition your government to produce electric and solar vehicles in order to eliminate the vast pollution of gas-powered vehicles.
